Extract the tables of a co-occurrence network summary

Source: R/methods.R
as.data.frame.summary.cooccurrence.Rd

as.data.frame() returns the node table or the group table of a summary.cooccurrence() object as a plain data frame, so the metrics can be sorted, filtered, joined or plotted with ordinary data-frame tools.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'summary.cooccurrence'
as.data.frame(
  x,
  row.names = NULL,
  optional = FALSE,
  what = c("nodes", "groups"),
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A summary.cooccurrence object.

row.names, optional

Unused; present for compatibility with the base::as.data.frame() generic.

what

"nodes" (default) for the node table, or "groups" for the group table of a split_by result.

...

Ignored.

Value

A base data.frame. For what = "nodes", one row per node (per node and group for a split_by result, with a leading group column), sorted by degree and strength (both decreasing) and then name, with columns node, degree (number of incident edges), strength (sum of incident edge weights), count_strength (sum of incident raw counts) and frequency (number of transactions containing the node; NA when not stored, as for aggregate_by and weighted results). For what = "groups", one row per group with columns group, n_nodes, n_edges, possible_edges, density, weight_mean and count_sum; zero rows when the network was not split.

See also

summary.cooccurrence(); as.data.frame.cooccurrence(), which returns the same tables directly from the network.

Examples

by_decade <- cooccurrence(movies, field = "genres", sep = ",",
                          split_by = "decade", similarity = "jaccard")
as.data.frame(summary(by_decade), what = "groups")
#>   group n_nodes n_edges possible_edges   density weight_mean count_sum
#> 1 1970s      20      53            190 0.2789474  0.11842267       158
#> 2 1980s      20      61            190 0.3210526  0.09031828       185
#> 3 1990s      20      54            190 0.2842105  0.10294475       204
#> 4 2000s      22      84            231 0.3636364  0.07101046       358
#> 5 2010s      20      94            190 0.4947368  0.06183414       592
#> 6 2020s      19      60            171 0.3508772  0.08369359       210
